text: {"lessons":["I will avoid repeatedly taking profits just for the satisfaction of locking in gains; I should keep positions when their expected returns and portfolio role still justify them.","I will reassess losing positions objectively rather than holding on to avoid realizing a loss or selling in reaction to pain; a loss alone does not determine the right decision.","My account value fell over these periods, so I will use a consistent, evidence-based plan for sizing and diversification instead of frequent reactive trades or buying more without a clear rationale."]}
